notices.support: A completed form, in duplicate, captioned "notice of cancellation", shall be attached to the contract signed by the buyer and be easily detachable
notices.summary_row: Home solicitation statement near signature and duplicate NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole statute section; besides the buyer statement and the NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form it holds operative rules (writing requirements, late cancellation, prohibited acts) that should not print in the customer's contract

notices.title: EXCESS COSTS statement with the owner's initials (written or oral estimate)
notices.trigger: Jobs of $25,000 or more, unless the contract is firm price with no excess costs or is cost-plus
notices.format: Statement in substantially the given language with an initials line: written estimate or oral estimate; no type size stated
notices.support: the contract shall include a statement in substantially the following language
notices.summary_row: Written contract at $25,000, required contents, EXCESS COSTS statement with initials
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole statute section; besides the EXCESS COSTS statement it holds the list of required contract contents and the exemptions, which should not print in the customer's contract

notices.title: Estimate form with the customer's initials (written, oral or no estimate)
notices.trigger: Repairs or services over $25 with face to face contact, which covers jobs under $25,000 and cleaning
notices.format: Form given at the first face to face contact and before work starts; may be separate or part of another form; also told to the customer orally
notices.support: Jobs under $25,000 and cleaning: "Estimate" form with initials (written, oral, no estimate), over $25
notices.summary_row: Jobs under $25,000 and cleaning: "Estimate" form with initials (written, oral, no estimate), over $25
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole administrative rule; besides the Estimate wording it holds many other operative rules (second sign, authorization of extra work, itemized bills) that should not print in the customer's contract

changes.new: Written contract required when the cost equals or exceeds $25,000 (R.C. 4722.02(A))
changes.support: 4722.02(A): "no home construction service supplier shall perform any home construction service the cost of which equals or exceeds twenty-five thousand dollars unless the supplier enters into a written home construction services contract with the owner."
not more than ten per cent of the contract price before the supplier's performance that is required by the contract begins

changes.new: 10 percent of the contract price before performance begins on R.C. 4722 jobs; 75 percent of a non-returnable special order item; not for cost-plus contracts
changes.support: not more than seventy-five per cent of the total cost of any special order item that is otherwise not returnable or usable

changes.new: Business day is any calendar day except Sunday and eleven named holidays, so Saturday counts
changes.support: "Business day" means any calendar day except Sunday, or the following business holidays
the seller shall not commence performance of such services during the time in which the buyer may cancel

unsure: OH-cancel: the buyer statement (1345.23(B)(1)) and the NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form (B)(2) belong in the contract, but the file only offers them inside the whole section block, so they are held.
OH-excess-cost: the EXCESS COSTS statement belongs in the contract but is only offered inside the whole 4722.02 block, so it is held.
OH-estimate-form: added as a form handed over before work on jobs under $25,000 and cleaning; the builder cannot tell the face to face contact condition, and the whole rule block is held anyway.
cancellation.no_work_or_payment_in_window: the file bars starting work during the window (1345.22(B)) but says nothing barring payment, so true may overstate the payment half.
Whether the home solicitation sections reach a $25,000-plus job is flagged by the file as a lawyer question, so OH-cancel's sold_in_home trigger is left as is.
